label: Diagram 2.20
caption: Diagram 2.20 Wall types 2.3 and 2.4 | – stagger
description: A plan headed "Diagram 2.20 Wall types 2.3 and 2.4 – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf – stagger", marked "PLAN" at the lower right. Two dwellings' external walls meet the separating wall at a stagger, so the external wall steps where they join. The "External leaf", drawn with single diagonal hatching, runs across the top and turns down at the step. Two masonry inner leaves, drawn cross-hatched and each labelled "Inner leaf", meet the two leaves of the separating wall at the step. A cross-hatched block fills the cavity at the junction, labelled "Cavity stop". A vertical dimension on the left, beside the stepped part of the external leaf, reads "At least 300mm".

Two plan diagrams appear side by side, each marked "PLAN" in the lower right corner.

The left diagram is headed "Diagram 2.20 Wall types 2.3 and 2.4 – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf – stagger". It shows a wall corner formed by an "External leaf" of diagonally hatched blocks and an "Inner leaf" of cross-hatched blocks, the inner leaf turning the corner with a stagger. An arrow labelled "Cavity stop" points to a cross-hatched block set into the cavity at the corner. A vertical double-headed arrow beside the projecting external leaf is dimensioned "At least 300mm".

The right diagram is headed "Diagram 2.22 Wall type 2 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf". It shows a similar corner junction: an "External leaf" of diagonally hatched blocks meeting an inner leaf drawn with a wavy-line timber-frame pattern. An arrow labelled "Cavity stop" points to a cross-hatched block in the cavity at the corner. No dimensions are given on this diagram.

model_description:
Two plan diagrams appear side by side, each marked "PLAN" in the lower right corner.

The left diagram is headed "Diagram 2.20 Wall types 2.3 and 2.4 – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf – stagger". It shows a wall corner formed by an "External leaf" of diagonally hatched blocks and an "Inner leaf" of cross-hatched blocks, the inner leaf turning the corner with a stagger. An arrow labelled "Cavity stop" points to a diagonally hatched block set into the cavity at the corner. A vertical double-headed arrow beside the projecting external leaf is dimensioned "At least 300mm".

The right diagram is headed "Diagram 2.22 Wall type 2 – external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf". It shows a corner junction in which a diagonally hatched external leaf meets an inner leaf drawn with a wavy-line timber-frame pattern; neither leaf is labelled on this diagram. The leg of the wall running to the right is drawn with cross-hatched blocks rather than the timber-frame pattern. An arrow labelled "Cavity stop" points to a diagonally hatched block in the cavity at the corner. No dimensions are given on this diagram.
